lines.trans: As one wise man said, the sun shines equally on everyone.
It warms both a couple in love and a lonely guy.
A lonely guy who has already forgotten what the sun is.
How exhausted I am today!
I work twenty-four hours a day like a slave.
Now the entire restaurant is completely on my shoulders.
I already told you about the restaurant, Dima.
Sell it to us, and you will have one less problem.
If I leave, everything here will collapse without me!
Nothing will collapse, what is the main thing in a restaurant?
What is the main thing in a restaurant, the kitchen and food, of course!
No, Dima, you are completely wrong here.
